```{=html}
<pre class="pseudocode" data-line-number="true">
\begin{algorithmic}
\Procedure{IterativeTreeSearch}{$x,k$}
\While{$x\ne\NIL$ \textbf{and} $k\ne x.key$}
\If{$k&lt;x.key$}\State $x\gets x.left$
\Else\State $x\gets x.right$\EndIf
\EndWhile
\State\Return $x$
\EndProcedure
\end{algorithmic}
</pre>
```
